This folder contains an unmodified subset of **video-shotcraft** by **Vincent Wei** (Vincentwei1021).

- Licence: Apache License 2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE) (the upstream file, unchanged)

Every file here except this `NOTICE.md` and `UPSTREAM.md` is a byte-for-byte copy of the upstream file at the pinned commit. Nothing has been modified, translated or reformatted. Only a subset of upstream is included (see UPSTREAM.md for what is and is not).

The shot cards and the demo source code are the work of Vincent Wei. The cards themselves note that they re-implement publicly observed motion techniques from scratch; their own `references/shots/ATTRIBUTION.md` explains the sources and the legal boundary the author set.

The studio's own shot library (`shot-library/` at the repo root) is a separate work written in our own words and structure. It points back to these files and credits the upstream card for each entry.

"Remotion" has its own licence (free for individuals and small teams; companies may need a paid licence). That is separate from this Apache-2.0 material.
